feed.title: We made the bitcoin-dev mailing list readable: 15 years, 24,699 messages

entry.title: We made the bitcoin-dev mailing list readable: 15 years, 24,699 messages
entry.summary:
A comprehensive enhancement has been implemented in the Bitcoin BIP archive, introducing a feature that specifies where each BIP is integrated within Bitcoin Core. Every BIP page now includes an “In Bitcoin Core” section detailing the version in which the BIP was first introduced, subsequent versions that modified it, and verbatim notes from Core’s doc/bips.md file, complete with pull request references. For instance, on the [BIP 141](https://www.learnbitcoin.com/archive/bips/141) page, users can review its introduction in version 0.13.0, its mainnet definition in 0.13.1, and its burial as of 0.19.0, alongside threads discussing this BIP.
The documentation encompasses all 74 BIPs listed in doc/bips.md, ensuring thorough coverage. Additionally, the archive features individual pages for every Bitcoin Core release from version 0.1.5 onward, totaling 137 releases. Each page provides the release date, relevant threads including release candidates and official announcements, the BIPs initially shipped with that release, and direct links to accompanying notes. The release records indicate that the latest available announcement is for version 24.0.1, dated December 2022.
The accuracy of this mapping is dependent on the information in doc/bips.md. If there are BIPs implemented in Core that are missing from the file or if versioning details are inaccurate, updates to doc/bips.md will be reflected in the archive at the next refresh. Corrections to mismatched release threads can also be submitted to maintain the integrity of the resource.
Further improvements include increasing the refresh frequency of the archive to twice daily, enhancing the timeliness of updates. Moreover, user records have been consolidated, merging seven individuals who previously had their correspondence split across multiple email addresses into unified profile pages. The full archive and release list can be explored at [https://www.learnbitcoin.com/archive/releases](https://www.learnbitcoin.com/archive/releases).
